item.coloph: grubs (sgrab) gnas dam pa rtse drug lhun rgangs su (sgang du )dus mtha'i rnal 'byor mi shig rdo rje bdag la snyan du rgyud bdag gis sbas dang gsang rgya thub par byas dad ldan grogs po'i can (rkyen) gyis bskul ba'i ngor dkar tshag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la mthol lo bshags bka' skyongs bsrungs (srung) ma rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob shogs(shog ) 13 'di'i dbu yi mtshan byang zhang zhung smar chung du bris 'dug par gzhung nang gshin nag sgrub gzhung du gsungs pas de ltar bris yod
